Function: manageBorgChargeTimer at 8012b458
Signature: undefined __stdcall manageBorgChargeTimer(int param_1)
Entry: 8012b458
Body: 8012b458 - 8012b553

analysis.summary: The function manages a Borg charge timer state machine. It initializes a timer if the state byte at offset 0x540 is zero, setting the timer value to 45.0 and invoking helper functions to configure the instance. If the timer is already active, it decrements the timer by a delta value at offset 0x1dc8. If the timer drops below or equals zero, it resets the state, clears specific flags at offset 0x5e0, and calls a cleanup helper. The function handles specific hardware IDs (0x607, 0x61b) to configure instance lifecycle callbacks.
hypotheses: The function name 'manageBorgChargeTimer' accurately describes the control flow of initializing and decrementing a timer value.
The helper at 0x8016c7ec takes three arguments (param_1, index, value) despite its decompile showing no arguments, likely due to register passing conventions or decompile limitations.
The value 0x607 (1543) and 0x61b (1563) at offset 0x3e8 represent specific Borg instance IDs or types requiring different lifecycle configurations.
The timer delta at offset 0x1dc8 represents the time elapsed since the last update.
unknowns: The exact semantic meaning of the flags cleared at offset 0x5e0.
The specific behavior of the helper functions 0x800107a0, 0x800f036c, and 0x8006a53c beyond their argument passing.
